description: This is a Python script named 'update_sidebar.py' that updates a Markdown sidebar file by including links to Markdown files located in a specific directory. The script scans the 'apis' directory for '.md' files, sorts them, and inserts corresponding links into the sidebar Markdown file, replacing a designated section marker.

methods.name: update_sidebar()
methods.description: Main function that updates the 'sidebar.md' file by inserting links to API markdown files found in the 'apis' directory. Handles locating the file, reading the existing content, finding the insertion point, regenerating the list of links, and writing back the updated content.
